chapter: Early career, theaters and Cobb's Tea Room
title: Trumpeter Frank Garante and his rotary-valve trumpet
summary: Allen asks about Frank Garante; DeDroit says they played duets and describes his Italian rotary-valve trumpet.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: There was a trumpet player there that I never have been able to find much about. And I thought maybe he was there right before you or right after you. Did you know Frank Garante? He was from Italy. Frank who?

Garante? Great. Frank Garante. Frank Garante. Which I say he was my contemporary. I've been a little ahead of him. Frank lived up at Exposition Boulevard magazine. He had an apartment there. I lived on a camp between Henry P. and Webster, which is close together. And we used to play duets together. And he played an Italian trumpet with the side action, you know.
Rotary valves, like a French horn.
